title: Scripture and Christ
definition: Scripture and Christ means the Bible faithfully reveals Jesus Christ as the center of God’s redemptive plan.
summary: Scripture and Christ means the Bible faithfully reveals Jesus Christ as the center of God’s redemptive plan.
christFocus: Jesus is the promised Savior, the fulfillment of Scripture, the living Word, and the One to whom the written Word bears witness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Bible is not merely a book of moral lessons, inspiring stories, or religious rules. Scripture reveals the living God and centers on His saving work through Jesus Christ. The Old Testament prepares for Him, the Gospels reveal Him, the apostolic writings explain His work, and the final hope of Scripture belongs to His reign.

Seeing Christ in Scripture does not mean forcing Jesus into every verse in careless ways. It means reading each passage faithfully within the whole story of God’s redemption. The promises, covenants, sacrifices, priesthood, kingdom, wisdom, and hope of Scripture find their fullness in Him.

Christ-centered reading protects believers from using the Bible without coming to the Savior. Knowledge that does not lead to Christ can become pride. True Scripture reading brings sinners, sufferers, servants, and teachers to the Lord Jesus.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people use the Bible for comfort, rules, debate, or inspiration while missing the One the Bible reveals. Scripture and Christ keeps the heart of Bible study clear: God’s Word leads us to Jesus.

This doctrine also helps those who feel disqualified. Scripture shows a Savior who seeks sinners, restores failures, welcomes the weary, and sends weak people by His grace.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Read Scripture with the question, “How does this passage reveal God and lead me to Christ?” Let the Word bring you to worship, trust, repentance, obedience, and deeper fellowship with the Savior who is revealed throughout the Bible.
